sam: Heads up — customer says they can still stream SIEM events after we rotated the export token. Looks like token revocation isn't cutting existing streams.

maria: Which export? the partner streaming pipeline or the raw-syslog forwarder?

jonas: Partner streaming (partner-abc). Exporter-service logs show auth failed for new handshakes but existing socket stayed open.

sam: That matches — we only reject new connections on auth failure. Need a revocation strategy for long-lived streams.

maria: Options: short-lived session tokens (5-15m) + refresh flow, or a revocation watcher that actively terminates sockets when a token id is revoked. Short TTLs hit scale though.

jonas: I lean revocation watcher + push to edge. Implementation: revoke -> publish id to pubsub -> proxies/drop connections for matching consumer_id.

sec-bot: Security note: when rotating keys, ensure exported metadata is re-wrapped and audit events emitted. See infra ticket SE-4321.

elaine: Legal: ephemeral tokens are fine, but we need an immutable audit trail of revocations and retained access logs for 24 months for compliance. Include who triggered revoke and reason.

sam: Agree. Also need an enforcement path for accidental long-lived connectors (eg self-hosted partners). Maybe require connector to use our refresh endpoint every N minutes.

maria: Plan sketch: 1) session token minted by auth-service with KMS envelope + HMAC sig, 2) stream proxy validates sig and consumer_id, 3) revocation pubsub forces proxy to kill connection, 4) export server logs revoke events to audit log (immutable).

jonas: Edge case: zero-downtime rotation — if we force-kill a connection mid-ingest, partner might drop data. We should support handoff: proxy can signal client to re-establish with new token and buffer small window.

sam: Good point. We'll document expected behavior in partner integration docs and surface retry guidance.

maria: Implementation tasks: prototype revocation-watcher + proxy hook. I'll spike this week.

jonas: I'll add lease expiry handling in exporter and a fast-path to drop if revocation flag present.

elaine: I'll draft the retention and audit requirements and share contract language.

sam: Action items: maria (revocation watcher + prototype), jonas (exporter lease + kill path), elaine (retention/audit copy). Filing SE-5210 to track.

sam: Quick token example for review: ```{ "wrap": "kms+envelope", "lease_ttl": 900, "consumer_id": "partner-abc", "sig": "HMAC_SHA256(base64)" }```

maria: :thumbsup: I'll post updates and link the spike PR in #eng-security.

jonas: If we need scale for fanout, suggest Redis or Kafka pubsub for revocation messages.

sec-bot: Reminder: add this to vuln triage agenda — transporter component may be impacted (SE-5102).

sam: Cool. Sync tomorrow standup 10:30am. SE-5210 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SE-5210
